# Learn JavaScript

> Free interactive JavaScript tutorial platform offering hands-on coding lessons from beginner basics to advanced asynchronous programming.

Learn JavaScript is a comprehensive, interactive learning platform created by Ron Reiter and supported by Boot.dev. It provides structured tutorials covering fundamental JavaScript concepts through advanced patterns like async/await and object-oriented programming, designed for beginners to intermediate developers.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Interactive Tutorials
- Asynchronous Programming
- Functions
- Arrays
- Objects
- Control Flow
- Promises
- Async/Await
- Arrow Functions
- Callbacks
- Data Structures
- Web Development
- Beginner Tutorial
- Free Course

## Getting Started

- [Hello, World!](https://learn-js.org/en/Hello%2C_World%21): Hello, World! beginner tutorial covering console.log basics
- [Variables and Types](https://learn-js.org/en/Variables_and_Types): Tutorial on JavaScript variables, var, const, and data types
- [Operators](https://learn-js.org/en/Operators): Guide to JavaScript operators and mathematical functions

## Core Language Concepts

- [Conditions](https://learn-js.org/en/Conditions): Tutorial on conditionals, if/switch statements, and control flow
- [Loops](https://learn-js.org/en/Loops): Guide to JavaScript loops: for, while, break, continue
- [Functions](https://learn-js.org/en/Functions): Guide to JavaScript functions, scope, and closures
- [Objects](https://learn-js.org/en/Objects): Tutorial on JavaScript objects and object-oriented basics

## Data Structures

- [Arrays](https://learn-js.org/en/Arrays): Guide to JavaScript Arrays data structure and indexing
- [Manipulating Arrays](https://learn-js.org/en/Manipulating_Arrays): Tutorial on array manipulation: push, pop, shift, splice

## Advanced Functions & Asynchronous Programming

- [Arrow Functions](https://learn-js.org/en/Arrow_Functions): Tutorial on ES6 arrow functions and modern function syntax
- [Callbacks](https://learn-js.org/en/Callbacks): Guide to JavaScript callbacks and asynchronous programming
- [Promises](https://learn-js.org/en/Promises): Guide to JavaScript Promises and async/await patterns
- [Async and Await](https://learn-js.org/en/Async_and_Await): Tutorial on async/await syntax for asynchronous programming

## Object-Oriented Programming

- [Object Oriented JavaScript](https://learn-js.org/en/Object_Oriented_JavaScript): Guide to object-oriented programming with classes and constructors

## Browser APIs

- [Pop-up Boxes](https://learn-js.org/en/Pop-up_Boxes): Tutorial on JavaScript popup boxes: alert, confirm, prompt

## About

- [About Learn JavaScript](https://learn-js.org/about): About page describing learn-js.org and creator Ron Reiter
- [Learn JavaScript Homepage](https://learn-js.org): Homepage for learn-js.org, free interactive JavaScript tutorial
